source.label: Bally Little Joe reproduction instruction cards

strategy.overview: Little Joe combines white and yellow dice to control gates and awards, but its upper-right saucer is the dependable scoring center. The saucer scores 3,000 unlit and 5,000 when the dice total is 7 or 11. A total of 6 opens the center gate; 8 enables the lower-gate route; 4 can light Extra Ball. Change the white die through a top lane and the yellow die with the yellow mushroom bumper.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Little Joe, shoot the upper-right saucer repeatedly: it scores 3,000 unlit and 5,000 when the white and yellow dice total 7 or 11. The plunge chooses the white die, while the yellow mushroom bumper advances the yellow die. A total of 6 opens the center gate, 8 opens the lower-gate route, and 4 can light Extra Ball.
strategy.summary: Treat the dice as a way to improve the saucer, not a reason to abandon it. Shoot the upper-right saucer whether lit or not. Use convenient plunges or bumper hits to reach 7 or 11, and the center post to prepare another controlled shot.

quickInfo.name: Upper-right saucer
quickInfo.summary: Score 3,000 unlit or 5,000 with a total of 7 or 11.

quickInfo.name: White die
quickInfo.summary: Set it with the top lane reached on a plunge or gate return.

quickInfo.name: Yellow die
quickInfo.summary: Advance it one step with each yellow mushroom-bumper hit.

quickInfo.name: Dice total 6
quickInfo.summary: Open the center gate; a return to the shooter scores 3,000.

quickInfo.name: Dice total 8
quickInfo.summary: Enable the scoring-gate or stand-up route that opens the lower gate.

quickInfo.name: Dice total 4
quickInfo.summary: Light Extra Ball at the indicated collect when enabled.

steps.text: Plunge a white-die lane that puts the combined total near 7 or 11.
Use yellow mushroom-bumper hits to advance the yellow die toward 7 or 11.
Shoot the upper-right saucer from the left flipper for 5,000 lit or 3,000 unlit.
Repeat the saucer shot instead of forcing a lower-value dice feature.
If the center post is raised, settle the ball against it and use microflips to prepare another left-flipper saucer shot.
Set the white die with a favorable top lane.
Advance the yellow die until the total reaches 7 or 11.
Repeat the now-lit upper-right saucer from the left flipper.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play, whether Extra Ball is enabled at dice total 4, gate behavior, and that the white and yellow dice indicators agree with their physical switches.

Test all six white-die lanes, yellow mushroom bumper and step unit, upper-right saucer and lamp, center and lower gates, indicated stand-up, scoring gate, center-post rollover and post, and shooter-return feed.
